checks: Signup sends HTML and text through real HTTP; API exposes status only, stored token and idempotency key are hashed
Email link verifies once and grants one credit; verified accounts do not send again
Missing configuration preserves account and zero credits; resend recovers after configuration is fixed
429, HTML 503, malformed success and disconnect report failure, never grant credits, and can recover by resend
Password recovery uses 30-minute template, conceals account existence and does not duplicate the welcome credit
Resend is limited to three per account per hour before any further provider call
A hanging provider is stopped by the real 15-second request timeout
Local HTTP override cannot target a public site or remote mock; HTML escapes link values
evidence: Actual auth routes, isolated SQLite and actual fetch to a local HTTP Resend stand-in; no real emails.
limitations: Postman CLI 1.13.1 has no Simulation/status command; owner mock discovery skipped. No verified Resend domain, provider delivery, inbox placement or real credentials tested.
